title: Diffu-LoRA：面向个性化扩散模型的新型低秩适配方法
summary: Diffu-LoRA 提出一种参数高效的扩散模型个性化方法，通过门控低秩适配在 Transformer 层中学习适配容量分配，结合双层优化与渐进剪枝，在保持主干冻结的情况下提升主体保真度与提示对齐。
summary_en: Diffu-LoRA introduces a parameter-efficient method for personalizing text-to-image diffusion models via gated low-rank adaptation. It learns nonuniform adaptation capacity allocation across Transformer layers using bilevel optimization and progressive pruning, improving subject fidelity and prompt alignment with a frozen backbone.
